title: Barycentric Local Coordinate and Inverse
objective: Represent local terminal position and enable profile-specific map-to-vector inversion.

repository_truth.head: de620bb
reused_engine: cwatlas.addressing (encode_path, barycentric, face_triangle), cwatlas.subdivision, cwatlas.localize (cell_centroid, localize_cell) - NOT reimplemented

implementation.inverse: point -> (route, family) via family arithmetic inverse of the encoded address
implementation.boundary_handling: near an edge/vertex the local coordinate is reported as an interval/region, not a crisp point

negative_results: The source route core is quantized: an arbitrary point is generally NOT exactly representable, so the inverse returns the nearest encodable point and does NOT claim exactness unless the residual is within tolerance (no invented precision).
A recovered route is a CALIBRATED_CANDIDATE under a declared family, not a measured fact; no source origin is validated.
Round-trip route -> point -> route is a verified property of the codec, not evidence any source vector identifies a real location.

claims.statement: Barycentric local coordinates and a profile-specific inverse recover a five-token route under a named family, with a nearest-encodable-point where the quantized codec cannot represent the point exactly.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic/public points and routes only; no private reads, no personal names or filesystem literals
